import SpecAdrChrome from '@beskid/beskid-ui/platform-spec/SpecAdrChrome.astro';

<SpecAdrChrome />

## Context

Monolithic IO.bd hid syscall direction and descriptor typing.

## Decision

| Rule | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Surface | `System.Input`, `System.Output`, `System.Error` under `packages/runtime` |
| Non-goal | Monolithic `IO.bd` for standard streams |

## Consequences

Syscall descriptors stay typed per stream.

## Verification anchors

`packages/runtime/src/System/`; stream contract tests.
